known_limits: Three independently authored scenarios do not establish causal improvement, universal Agent performance or ordinary-user success.
Existing Alpha.5 guidance informed the makers; added methods and curated references have not received a fresh native installed-model workflow.
Continuous graphics and their physical low-end-device performance were researched but not implemented in these cases.
AFTERIMAGE compact bar uses48px while browsing; LOOP permanent phone review uses69px and its small status repeats fuller recovery text.
CANOPY comparison costs vertical reading space; local recovery is not shared or cross-device storage.
Keyboard paths and browser failures were exercised; complete screen-reader and physical-device acceptance remain unverified.
